entries.name: createEditorStore

Creates the editor store. It is seeded from `doc()` (normalized, so every
form input has a value to bind; the source is never modified) and
re-seeded if `bricks()`, `collection()` or `doc()` change, e.g. when a
different document is loaded. Edits live in the store until then. The
first entry is selected, or the fields when there is no body.

members.name: onSave
members.doc:
Saves the document; without it there is no Save button. Resolve with a
`SaveResult` (e.g. from `Content.save`) to report validation problems,
or reject if saving failed. The editor validates before calling it too.

members.name: onRemove
members.doc: Deletes the document; without it there is no Delete button. The editor doesn't ask first: the handler does.

members.name: onDirtyChange
members.doc:
Called with whether there are unsaved changes, initially and whenever
that changes (only with `onSave`), and with false if the save controls
go away while dirty (the editor unmounts or `onSave` is removed). Use it
to guard in-app navigation, e.g. with the router's `useBeforeLeave`;
closing the tab is already guarded.

members.name: onFollowLink
members.doc:
Called when a same-origin link is ⌘/Ctrl-clicked in the preview (a plain
click selects the brick instead). Default: opens it in a new tab.
`<Admin>` opens the document it points to (see `AdminProps.resolveLink`).

members.doc:
Loads what the brick shows besides its own data, e.g. the latest posts.
Runs on the server when the page renders (pages without JavaScript
included) and in the browser in the admin preview, where it reads
saved content (not unsaved edits to other documents), again after each
save. Read the `data` fields it depends on before the first `await`:
changing those loads again, changing others doesn't. Return plain JSON. Write it before

members.doc:
Rendered in place of an entry whose brick isn't defined (e.g. a brick
that was removed from the code). Default: nothing, which suits a public

members.doc: Shown while a brick's first load is in flight. Default: nothing.

members.doc:
Shown in place of a brick whose load failed. Without it, the error
reaches the app's own error boundary (a server render fails with it);
the admin preview passes one. It clears when the brick loads again: when
data its loader read before its first `await` changes, or the source's

members.name: defaults
members.doc: Fresh default data.

members.name: validate
members.doc: Validates (and fills defaults into) unknown data.

members.name: normalize
members.doc:
Coerces unknown data into the schema's shape for rendering: missing fields
get defaults, and fields of the wrong type are replaced by their default.
Values that are the right type but break a rule (an empty required text)
are kept, so a preview shows what the editor typed.

The content reader for the current component, from `ContentContext`.
Call it in a component body; read with it in a memo (under `<Loading>`).

entries.name: validateDoc
entries.summary:
Checks a document before it is saved: its id and slug (not one of the
collection's reserved slugs), its fields against the collection's schema
(issues at `['fields', ...]`), and with a body its entries. Unknown
top-level keys are dropped. Whether the slug is free is the store's
question, not this one.
entries.signature: function validateDoc(collection: AnyCollection, bricks: readonly AnyBrick[], raw: unknown): ValidateDocResult

entries.name: ValidateDocResult
entries.summary: Result of `validateDoc`: the cleaned document, or every issue found.
entries.signature: type ValidateDocResult = { success: true; doc: Doc } | { success: false; issues: DocIssue[] }

entries.name: validateEntries
entries.summary:
Checks entries before they are saved: each entry's shape, unique ids, and
its data against its brick's schema. Problems are pushed onto `issues`
(shape problems at `['entries', index]`); the returned entries have each
known brick's validated data, and entries of unknown bricks are kept as
they are, so retiring a brick never loses content.
entries.signature: function validateEntries(bricks: readonly AnyBrick[], raw: readonly unknown[], issues: EntryIssue[]): PageEntry[]

entries.name: ValidateResult
entries.summary: Result of `brick.validate(data)`.
entries.signature: type ValidateResult<D> = { success: true; data: D } | { success: false; issues: Issue[] }

entries.name: createJsonFileStore
entries.summary:
A content store backed by JSON files. Collection names and slugs are
checked, so neither can escape `dir`. A file that can't be parsed is
skipped when listing (and logged), so one bad file doesn't break every
list on the site, but reading it directly throws.

members.name: dir
members.doc: Directory holding one folder per collection, resolved against the working directory. Created on first save.
